before: A room applied typing, a deletion or a move into one of Word's own notes (a separator, a continuation separator or a continuation notice), which the editor shows to nobody; a conversion of one was refused as invalid-edit.
after: Every change that names a place in one of Word's own notes is refused as hidden-target, for the organiser and a party alike, live and after a fold, at the same place where a note that does not show is refused.
reason: Change messages, the change log, checkpoints and the Yjs format do not change; every copy refuses the same changes with the same reason. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
